title: Nightshift flip cheats — quick operator notes
content:
Context and intent:
- Quick reference for small-window flips during late maintenance windows.
- Intended to be terse — for on-call/operator use when traffic is being shifted between model variants or service images.
- Not a full runbook; supplement with SRE runbook + platform console.

High-level goal:
- Move <=5% traffic from model-v2025-11b -> model-v2026-01a over a 30m observation window.
- Maintain 99th pct latency within 1.5x baseline, error-rate increase <= 0.2 percentage points.

Before flip (T-minus 40m) quick checklist:
- Confirm capacity: Dedicated pool available (tag: night-ops-pool), GPU util < 60% last 30m.
- Confirm model artifacts deployed and healthy: model-v2026-01a status = READY in model catalog.
- Ensure roadmap toggles: disable aggressive batching for first 10m (config: batching.max_batch_ms=20).
- Notify Slack channel #night-ops (template below).
- Snapshot baseline metrics (run queries below and paste results into incident thread).

Baseline queries (copy/paste):
- 1) Error rate (last 1h): sum(rate(redwood_request_errors_total[1h])) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1h]))
- 2) 95p latency (app): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
- 3) GPU util (pool): avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="night-ops-pool"}[30m])
- 4) KV cache hit ratio: sum(kv_cache_hits) / sum(kv_cache_lookups)

Operator flip steps (T=0 -> small drip):
1) Apply traffic rule: route 3% -> model-v2026-01a (API: POST /routing/rules with body {"match":"all","fraction":0.03,"variant":"model-v2026-01a"}).
   - If using console, use 'Create fraction rule' and pick 'gradual' = OFF (we do manual).
2) Watch for first 2 minutes for surge in 5xx or latency > baseline*1.5.
3) After 10m, if stable, increase to 5%. If not stable, immediately trigger rollback (steps below).

Signals to watch (fast-fail triggers):
- 5xx rate > baseline + 0.5pp for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
- 95p latency > baseline * 2 sustained for 5m.
- Token-level cost spike +30% (unexpected tokenization loop).
- Prometheus alert: redwood_request_error_budget_burn > 0.2

Immediate rollback (fast path):
- If any trigger fires: revert routing rule to previous state (API: DELETE /routing/rules/<id> or POST set fraction 0.0).
- Post a short note in #night-ops: "Rollback: model-v2026-01a -> 0% due to latency/error signal. Capturing traces now."
- Run sample trace extraction: curl -sS "https://ops-api/trace/extract?from=now-10m&tag=model-v2026-01a" > /tmp/traces.json

If degraded but marginal (do not rollback immediately):
- Reduce fraction by half and add 30s wait. Example: 5% -> 2.5%
- Temporarily set conservative kernel: MODEL_RUNTIME_CONFIG=set('max_concurrency', 8) via /admin/runtime-config
- Enable extra tracing for the variant (sampling: 100% for 1m) to capture first-failure cause.

Post-flip checks (first 60m):
- Check latency percentiles at 5m, 15m, 30m marks.
- Confirm error logs for model mismatch/tokenizer errors (grep for "tokenizer:unknown-token" or "KVCacheEvict").
- Confirm cost delta: billing estimate dashboard — token spend delta <= expected threshold set in PR.

Operator command snippets (copy/paste safe):
- Route 3% via CLI: rwctl route add --variant model-v2026-01a --fraction 0.03 --note "nightshift quick test"
- Remove rule: rwctl route remove --id 8423  # from route list
- Force rollback: rwctl route set --variant model-v2026-01a --fraction 0.0 --reason "fast-rollback"
- Dump recent errors: kubectl logs -l app=redwood-serving -c inference --since=15m | grep -i "error" | head -n 200

Suggested Slack template (paste into #night-ops):
- "Starting nightshift flip: 3% -> model-v2026-01a. Watch 95p latency and 5xx. Baseline 95p=120ms. Ping if >240ms or 5xx delta >0.5pp. Owner: @lena. Collab: @samir @ava"

Open questions / parking lot:
- If token-cost abnormality appears, how to quickly switch to quantized fallback variant? (quick path: rwctl variant swap --from model-v2026-01a --to model-v2026-01a-quant --fraction 1.0) — need approval owners list?
- Confirm whether autoscaler will start extra nodes at 80% GPU util or if it is 85% (doc mismatch). File ticket JIRA-3289 to reconcile.

Notes to self (observational heuristics learned):
- First 2m often shows slight spike in 95p due to cache cold-start; expect small blip but not >1.5x.
- Tokenizer-version mismatches show up quickly in traces as repeated short requests (tiny token counts) + high error message rate.
- Degradation from kernel mismatch tends to be steady latency increase, not bursty errors.

After-action quick log (template to paste into JIRA or thread):
- Started: TIME, fraction 3% -> model-v2026-01a
- Observed: 95p latency Xms (baseline Yms), 5xx delta Zpp
- Action: (increase/decrease/rollback) and why
- Traces attached: /tmp/traces.json
- Follow-up: ticket list (JIRA-xxxx)

Todo (short):
- [ ] Add small test harness that simulates half-second multimodal prompts to uncover tokenizer loops.
- [ ] Confirm autoscaler config with infra (JIRA-3289).
- [ ] Bake quick-runbook for quantized fallback swap and get signoff.

End — keep this doc minimal, update with any new quick commands or learned thresholds.

Notes: this is a living scratchpad; drop anything longer into the SRE runbook when stable.
